purpose.summary: This program (ORCBPRVPRT) is part of the ORCA JMA (Japan Medical Association) standard medical receipt software. It prints a preview check list ('receipt check list') by reading from a preview database and outputting formatted error/check records. It handles job management, patient number conversion, system date handling, and formatted print output.

notable_features: Japanese-encoded comments and string literals (Shift-JIS/EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1 causing mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses a proprietary MCP (Message Control Program) database access layer via CALL statements
Extensive use of COPY statements for copybooks (CPPRVKANRI.INC, CPSYSKANRI.INC, CPPTINF.INC, etc.)
UNSTRING used to parse comma-delimited command-line parameters
File STATUS checking on sequential error file (RECEERR-FILE)
No COMP-3 usage despite being a production financial/medical system
verdict.notes: The file contains Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS that was decoded as latin-1, resulting in garbled multi-byte characters in comments and string literals. The program is clearly part of the open-source ORCA JMA medical receipt system (copyright 2002 JMA). Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 29455 bytes, so the PROCEDURE DIVISION is only partially visible, but enough structure is present for confident classification.
